Title: Senior DevOps Engineer
Description:
We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to join our product. We are estimating, invoicing and payment software platform for small & medium-sized trade contractors and we have major growth planned. We give our customers the software tools & the best practices needed to deliver incredible home renovation experiences to homeowners.  
 
Responsibilities:    
Cloud Infrastructure Design: Design, implement, and maintain scalable, secure, and cost-efficient infrastructure using AWS services such , ECS, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, and CloudFront. Balance managed and serverless offerings to deliver high-performance, resilient systems tailored to product needs.   
Infrastructure as Code: Champion declarative, reproducible infrastructure using tools like Terraform and CloudFormation. Contribute to a culture of GitOps and configuration management that promotes visibility, automation, and reviewability across environments.   
System Architecture & Design: Translate business problems into modular, distributed system architectures. Apply sound engineering judgment to determine what to build and where to simplify. Design for observability, failure recovery, and long-term operability from the start.   
Platform Reliability: Build and maintain highly available systems with automated failover, scaling, and monitoring using Prometheus, Grafana, and Cloud-native tooling. Work closely with SRE and application teams to minimize MTTR and ensure zero-downtime deployments.   
DevOps Enablement: Establish and evolve CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or GitLab CI) that empower teams to deploy frequently and safely. Drive continuous delivery practices, automated testing, and secure-by-default deployment standards.   
Technical Leadership: Lead by example through hands-on contributions and deep technical guidance. Provide mentorship and elevate the team’s engineering maturity through design reviews, pair programming, and shared postmortem learnings.   
Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with developers, product managers, and security stakeholders to ensure infrastructure decisions align with product strategy, compliance, and user experience goals. Contribute to planning and execution cycles by making platform costs, risks, and capabilities visible.   
Operational Excellence: Establish robust monitoring, alerting, logging, and tracing strategies for platform components. Identify and remove toil through self-service tools, documentation, and automated recovery patterns.  
 
Skills & Experience Required  
Cloud Expertise: 5+ years of hands-on experience architecting and managing AWS environments, including, ECS, Lambda, CloudFormation, S3, RDS, Route 53, and VPC.  
Infrastructure as Code: Production experience with Terraform and CloudFormation for provisioning and managing cloud-native infrastructure at scale.  
Serverless Systems: Deep familiarity with event-driven and serverless architectures using AWS Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS, and Step Functions.  
CI/CD Mastery: Experience designing CI/CD pipelines using tools like GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or Bitbucket. Strong advocate for automated testing, linting, and deployment gating.  
Observability: Comfortable with implementing monitoring, logging, and alerting using Prometheus, Grafana, New Relic, ELK, or equivalent.  
Distributed Systems Design: Solid foundation in building decoupled, scalable systems using pub/sub or message queues (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ, AWS SNS/SQS).  
Languages: Proficient in at least one backend language (e.g., Python, Ruby, Go, or Java). Ability to read and contribute across service boundaries.  
API & Service Design: Strong experience designing REST or GraphQL APIs and implementing back-end services to support cross-platform applications.  
Security & Compliance Awareness: Understands security best practices in cloud environments including IAM, secrets management, encryption, and cost visibility.  
Agile & DevOps Mindset: Proven ability to deliver incrementally, respond to feedback, and work collaboratively in a lean, fast-paced environment.   
 
Readiness to work from 15 to 23 Kyiv Time!

Title: AI Engineer (Backend-Focused, Node.js + Python)
Description:
We’re looking for an AI Engineer to join our outsourcing team — not a pure ML researcher, but a pragmatic, data-driven backend engineer who knows how to put LLMs, vision APIs, and off-the-shelf models to work inside real products.
 
Most of our work isn’t training models from scratch — it’s understanding the business logic, collecting and cleaning data, wiring it into LLMs or services like AWS Textract, and shipping the result as a reliable API inside our existing platform.
 
If you’ve spent the last few years building APIs and integrations, you’re comfortable with data, and you’ve leaned hard into Cursor or Claude Code to deliver projects faster — this is for you.
 
What you’ll do
Build and ship LLM-powered features: prompt design, data prep, passing context to the model, parsing and validating output, returning clean APIs.
Design and implement integrations between our product and third-party AI services (OpenAI, Anthropic, Hugging Face models, AWS Textract, etc.).
Take document-processing and computer-vision tasks end-to-end: ingest → Textract/vision API → post-process → structured output consumed by our backend.
Write backend services and APIs in Node.js (our primary backend), dropping into Python when a task calls for it (model work, data scripts, fine-tuning).
Fine-tune existing models and prompts — not from scratch, but iterating on what’s already in place to get better accuracy, cost, or latency.
Do the unglamorous but critical work: data collection, cleaning, transformation, pattern-finding — often by letting an LLM do the heavy lifting on structured and unstructured input.
Maintain and improve existing AI and automation workflows already running in production.
Monitor cost and performance of model/API usage, propose optimizations, and forecast costs for new features.
Prepare and present demos and solution overviews to U.S.-based clients.
Document architecture, prompts, and pipelines in Confluence.
 
What we’re looking for
2+ years shipping production backend systems, with meaningful hands-on experience integrating LLMs or AI APIs into real products.
Strong in Node.js with the flexibility to work in Python — or a Python engineer who’s comfortable committing Node.js code. We need someone fluent on both sides; pure-Python candidates won’t be a fit.
Solid grasp of algorithms and data structures — enough to write custom logic when an LLM or library can’t cover the case.
Real experience with LLM integrations: OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar. Prompt engineering, function/tool calling, structured output, retrieval, evaluation.
Familiarity with the Hugging Face ecosystem — picking models, running inference, fine-tuning where it makes sense.
API and integrations background: REST, auth, webhooks, rate limits, retries, idempotency — the stuff that makes integrations not break at 2 a.m.
Comfortable with data work: collecting, cleaning, transforming, and analyzing data (SQL, pandas, or the Node equivalents).
Working knowledge of AWS — especially Textract, Lambda, S3, and the services around document and data pipelines. Bonus for Athena, Glue, Kinesis, SageMaker.
Exposure to NLP and Computer Vision concepts — enough to pick the right tool and evaluate results, not necessarily to train SOTA models.
Familiarity with CI/CD and deploying AI-powered services to production.
Experience building chatbot workflows — conversational flows, multi-turn logic, context management — is a plus, as this is among our planned projects.
AI-native delivery workflow. You use Cursor or Claude Code daily and know how to ship a project with minimal hand-written code — scoping work for the agent, reviewing generated code critically, orchestrating multi-step tasks, and getting to shipped quality faster than a traditional workflow. If you can’t describe how you use these tools to deliver, this role isn’t the right fit.
 
Nice to have
Experience fine-tuning open-source LLMs or vision models on domain-specific data.
Background in fintech, healthcare, or construction domains.
Experience with vector databases, RAG pipelines, or agentic workflows.
 
What we offer
Competitive salary with regular reviews.
Support for individual entrepreneurs with accounting assistance.
Fully remote work.
A clear path for professional development and growth.
A friendly team environment and engaging team-building activities (online and offline).

- Help standardise reusable integration control requirements and “control contracts” for regulated vendors and critical third parties.
- Support scope management and change control by documenting the impacts of requirement changes on compliance obligations, certification scope, and delivery plans.

5) Cross-functional collaboration
- Build strong working relationships across Product, Engineering, Infrastructure, Security, Legal.
- Act as a trusted partner to product and technical teams on how regulatory requirements apply to specific features, workflows, and jurisdictions.
- Communicate requirements, risks, trade-offs, and priorities clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
- Help identify compliance gaps and support remediation planning for new features, market launches, and platform changes.

Title: Reputation Manager - Leaply
Description:
Hi! We’re Leaply — a fast-growing ecosystem of digital and physical products designed to help people build healthier habits and lead better lives. We launched in 2024 and have already seen explosive growth with strong traction across the US, Europe, and beyond.
 
At Leaply, we value ownership over job titles, and impact over process. As we scale, we’re looking for a sharp, data-driven Reputation Manager to own our brand’s digital presence — from App Store ratings to Reddit conversations — and turn our customers’ voice into a competitive advantage.
 
In this role, you’ll own the full reputation function: building monitoring systems, managing reviews, executing ORM/SERM/ASO strategy, and shaping how millions of people perceive Leaply.
 
What you’ll do:
 
Own Online Reputation: Monitor and manage brand presence across Trustpilot, Reddit, Quora, and other key platforms — proactively identifying threats and opportunities.
Drive App Store Performance: Manage reviews and ratings on App Store & Google Play, developing and executing strategies to increase ratings and conversion.
Build Organic Presence: Execute ORM/SERM/ASO strategy to improve brand visibility and sentiment in organic search and app stores.
Analyze & Report: Build dashboards and reporting systems to track reputation metrics across all assets and deliver actionable insights to the team.
Content & Outreach: Coordinate owned media content (blog, Medium, Reddit), conduct journalist outreach, and manage relationships with creators and influencers.
First Look & SERP Analysis: Conduct regular brand SERP audits and competitive reputation landscape monitoring.
AI-powered workflows: Leverage AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity) to accelerate research, content production, monitoring automation, and competitive analysis.
 
You’re a great fit if you:
 
Have proven SERM / ORM / Brand Monitoring experience: you understand Google SERP dynamics, how brand reputation is shaped, and how platforms like Trustpilot, Reddit, and YouTube interact.
Are a strong communicator: English C1, comfortable conducting external outreach, negotiating placements, and writing content for Tier-1 markets.
Are data-driven: you work fluently with Google Sheets, Ahrefs/SEMrush/SimilarWeb, build dashboards, and use data to guide decisions.
Are AI-fluent: You actively use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, etc.) in your daily workflow — for research, drafting content, building monitoring pipelines, and speeding up repetitive tasks. You know how to prompt well and think about AI as a multiplier, not a novelty.
Understand content coordination: you can write briefs for content teams, maintain brand TOV, and align messaging across platforms.
Are tech-savvy: experience with project management tools (Notion, Jira/Asana) and brand monitoring systems.
Bonus points for:
Hands-on experience with ASO and App Store optimization.
Experience with influencer/YouTube outreach or digital PR.
Managing freelancers and external contractors.
Knowledge of LLM-based reputation tools and AI-driven content production.
Experience with Paid PR placements (Yahoo Finance, BBN Times, PR Newswire, etc.).
 
What you’ll get:
 
Competitive compensation and full ownership of the reputation function — you build the system from scratch.
Real impact: Shape how millions of people across the world discover and trust Leaply.
Office in Kyiv or Warsaw with perks (lunches, health insurance, gym).
Access to internal professional communities (Marketing, Product, Operations) within the SKELAR network.
A meaningful mission: Help millions of people live healthier lives every day.
Leaply is backed by SKELAR, a venture builder with over 10 successful B2C businesses. Beyond business, we support the SKELAR Foundation, a charitable initiative created by employees to support the Ukrainian Armed Forces.
 
Join us in building the next big thing!

We build demand generation and performance systems — not one-off campaigns. No account managers, no bureaucracy. Direct communication, results over process. 
 
We're growing and looking for a Digital Analytics Consultant to own the analytical layer across client engagements.

WHAT THIS ROLE IS
This is not a dashboarding job. 
Your core task: find where revenue leaks, explain why, and quantify the business impact. You'll work directly with the founder, get full access to clients' revenue stacks (CRM, ad accounts, financials), and own the deliverables that drive client decisions. 

You'll cover three core products: 
– Revenue Architecture Diagnostic 
– AI Visibility Audit 
– AI Revenue Operations Audit

WHAT YOU'LL DO
– Ingest and process data from web analytics platforms, CRM, ad accounts, and email tools
– Build attribution models and detect tracking gaps across the funnel
– Calculate CAC, LTV, payback period, and margin from real client data
– Run funnel drop-off and revenue leak analysis
– Run citation testing for AI Visibility audits (40–60 queries × 5 platforms per audit)
– Support process mapping for AI RevOps audits
– Write revenue audit reports (30–45 pages) and process audit reports (25–35 pages)
– Build ROI projection models in Excel / Google Sheets

WHAT WE EXPECT
– Own 3–4 client audits in parallel at different delivery stages
– Work autonomously — no step-by-step briefs, no micromanagement
– Surface both revenue leaks and growth upside — not just metrics
– Translate findings into decision-ready insights for CEOs and CMOs
– Back every recommendation with revenue logic and ROI modeling
– Write well — analytical writing quality directly affects client output
 
THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF
– You treat analytics as dashboards and reports without interpretation
– You rely on pre-built data infrastructure and can't build from scratch
– You're not comfortable with messy, fragmented, multi-source client data
– You can't back up recommendations with revenue modeling
– You're looking for a permanent salaried position from day one
 
CONDITIONS
– Fully remote, async-first
– Contract / freelance start — ~20 hrs/week, scaling with delivery performance
– No probation: the first project is the screen
– Path to Festanstellung opens at the 6+ month mark
 
SELECTION PROCESS
CV review → Recruiter screening → Case Interview with CEO (real dataset: web analytics export + CRM + ad spend, live walkthrough) → Referral check → Offer

Title: Software Engineer and Security Researcher
Description:
We're hiring a Software Engineer and Security Researcher to help build our top-tier cybersecurity product. This is a hybrid role by design: a strong software engineer who also brings a deep cybersecurity background. 
Strong engineering velocity is how features get shipped; serious security expertise is how those features get shipped right. You should have an understanding of how attackers and defenders actually operate.
The product space is CSPM/CNAPP-related, but extends beyond it. Expect to work across cloud posture, identity, attack paths, prioritization, detection, and adjacent areas as the product
evolves. The pace is high. AI is part of how we work, every day.
 
Responsibilities
Design, build, and ship product features end-to-end: from security research to architecture and production code to release.
Apply cybersecurity expertise to every feature decision: what to detect, how to model risk, what makes a finding actionable, where customers will be misled by noise, and how to translate raw cloud signal into something a security team can trust and act on.
Own cloud security capabilities across CSPM and beyond: posture, identity, attack paths, severity/prioritization, detections, and emerging areas of the platform.
Drive AI into the development loop. Use coding agents and LLM tools as a core part of how you design, prototype, build, debug, review, and document. Write strong prompts,
evaluate outputs critically, and turn AI-generated work into production-quality code and logic.

Move fast, with judgment. Make tradeoffs explicit, ship iteratively, and learn from real customer signals.
Collaborate closely with product, research, and engineering peers: clear written specs, sharp communication, clean handoffs, customer-facing rationale.
Requirements
5+ years as a software engineer. You design systems, write production code, reason about reliability and edge cases, and own delivery end-to-end.
Strong cybersecurity foundation. You understand threats, controls, identity, cloud risk, and why a “finding” is or isn’t worth a customer’s attention. This is what makes your feature decisions land.
Hands-on experience developing with AI / AI-driven development. This is a MUST. You have meaningfully shipped work where coding agents, LLM tools, or in-IDE AI assistants were a core part of how you built it. You can speak in detail about what worked, what didn’t, and how you got real leverage out of these tools.
Experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS preferred; Azure or GCP also valid).
Comfortable operating at high pace: small batches, fast iteration, willingness to cut scope to ship, calm under pressure.
Strong communication: you can explain engineering and security tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
 
Your primary language isn't a filter. In the AI era, switching stacks is a low-cost operation, we do it routinely, and people across the company are now contributing features end-to-end. 
 
Nice to Have
Experience building CSPM/CNAPP products, cloud security detection/analytics pipelines, or other top-tier security products.
Experience building or fine-tuning AI-powered developer workflows: custom agents, pipelines, evals, internal AI tooling, prompt frameworks.
Familiarity with cloud telemetry/log sources and correlating security signals across configuration, identity, and activity.
Infrastructure-as-Code (e.g., Terraform) and cloud-native development experience.
Prior security research background: vulnerability research, threat research, or detection engineering.

Remote-first setup, flexible working hours and unlimited vacation policy
Supportive and collaborative atmosphere with flat hierarchies and BS-free environment
Full tax and expense coverage, all necessary equipment, tools, and resources
Competitive base salary with generous performance-based bonuses
Comprehensive insurance coverage, gym memberships, office lunches, and more
Annual educational budget for professional development

Title: Senior Data Analyst/BI Developer
Description:
Join a Company That Invests in You
 
Seeking Alpha is the world's leading community of engaged investors. We’re the go-to destination for investors looking for actionable stock market opinions, real-time market analysis, and unique financial insights. At the same time, we’re also dedicated to creating a workplace where our team thrives. We’re passionate about fostering a flexible, balanced environment with remote work options and an array of perks that make a real difference.
 
What We're Looking For
 
Do you look at websites and think about how they might be personalized? Do you use websites and apps and think about how their features have been designed to be best for a lot of different users? Do you read articles with statistics and think about how they may be misinterpreting the data to get their results? If these things describe you, and if you’re great at SQL and have experience analyzing website data, you’re someone we want to talk to.
 
We’re looking for a Senior Data Analyst with experience analyzing website data. Our data analyst team analyzes everything on our website, not only for their immediate use but also for how they connect to high-level company KPIs. Our Analysts analyze raw data, not only pre-aggregated data, to extract just the right information and diagnose what is happening on our site.
 
The role requires understanding web development and how data is gathered, analysis of site usage and a/b tests, data visualization, and how different kinds of data can be presented most clearly, and business KPIs and how they are measured.
 
But more than that, we’re looking for experienced analysts who can bring us new ideas about how to analyze and extract insights from website data. Our ideal candidates have measured KPIs that we haven’t measured or used new ways to explain user retention, or analyzed features of users' data that we haven’t analyzed.
 
The best thing about our work is that we’re part of an incredibly data-driven company. Everyone from the CEO down uses data every day. The data teams are involved in every single thing the company does.
 
What You'll Do
 
Analyzing the behavior of users on our site and apps:
-Build and maintain dashboards that visualize the usage of single or multiple features and how that usage drives company KPIs.
-Answer questions about site usage or user behavior based on deeper analyses.
Analyze and track high-level KPIs such as conversion, retention, churn, recurring revenue, engagement, cross-device usage, e-mail and notification usage, and more.
Communicate with business stakeholders on analysis results, how they relate to business, and what business suggestions result from the analysis.
Run the whole data flow for site and app features, from defining KPIs, specifying data collection for development team implementation, and building and maintaining iterative versions of dashboards with both low-level and high-level views of collected data.
Split tests of product features:
-Design a test with clear success criteria
-Monitor test integrity
-Analyze results and give recommendations
-Use segmentation and clear cohort analysis to validate significant conclusions
-Conduct exploratory analysis to identify trends and opportunities
 
Requirements
 
A minimum of 5 years in a B2C website-related Data Analyst position
Strong SQL skills with experience writing complex and efficient analytical queries
Demonstrated experience with working in English directly with business stakeholders, understanding their needs, and explaining results
Understanding of website development and operations and how they connect to data gathered.
Experience with data visualization tools (Looker/Tableau/PowerBI, etc.)
Experience with report writing and technical requirements analysis, business process modeling/mapping, methodology development, and data modeling

Experience with AWS services, including EC2, S3, Athena, Kinesis/Firehose Lambda and EMR

Title: Chief Information Security Officer (CISO)
Description:

The Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) is the C-suite executive accountable for
information security, cyber resilience, and corporate IT operations across the group. Operating
in a regulated, multi-jurisdictional PSP and fintech environment spanning card acquiring &
gateway, card issuing / BaaS, and crypto / Web3 payment rails, the CISO defines and executes
the enterprise security strategy, safeguards cardholder data, customer funds, private keys, and
proprietary platforms, and ensures continuous compliance with PCI DSS, PSD2/SCA, GDPR,
DORA, NIS2, MiCA, SOC 2, ISO 27001, FCA/EBA expectations, and equivalent requirements in
other operating jurisdictions. In addition to leading security, the CISO owns corporate IT
— internal infrastructure, endpoints, identity, productivity tooling, and IT service delivery -and
drives its modernization in lockstep with business growth.

Key Responsibilities:
Security Strategy & Governance
• Define, own, and execute the multi-year information security and cyber resilience
strategy aligned with business growth, product roadmap, and regulatory obligations.
• Establish and maintain the Information Security Management System (ISMS) based on
ISO 27001, NIST CSF, and PCI DSS control frameworks.
• Report security posture, risks, incidents, and investment needs to the CEO, Executive
Committee, and Board on a regular cadence.
• Set and enforce enterprise security policies, standards, and acceptable use across all
business units.

Regulatory Compliance & Risk Management
• Maintain continuous compliance with PCI DSS Level 1, PSD2/SCA, GDPR, DORA,
NIS2, MiCA (for crypto activity), SOC 1/SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001/27017/27018, and
EBA/FCA guidelines, plus equivalent obligations in other operating jurisdictions.
• Own the security risk register, third-party / vendor risk program, and risk treatment plans;
ensure alignment with enterprise risk management and the CRO.
• Lead external and internal audits, QSA assessments, penetration tests, and regulatory
examinations; remediate findings within agreed timelines.
• Oversee data protection program in coordination with the DPO, including DPIAs, data
residency, cross-border transfers, and breach notification procedures.

Cybersecurity Operations & Engineering
• Operate a 24/7 Security Operations Center (SOC) covering threat detection, monitoring, incident response, digital forensics, and threat intelligence across acquiring, issuing, and crypto rails.
• Lead the response to security incidents, payment fraud events, account-takeover, and data breaches; act as the primary executive interface with regulators (FCA, EBA,national CAs), card schemes, acquirers, and law enforcement during incidents.
• Mature vulnerability management, red/purple teaming, and threat hunting across multicloud (AWS/GCP/Azure), Kubernetes, on-prem, PCI cardholder data environments(CDE), and crypto custody/HSM enclaves.
• Drive Zero Trust architecture, network segmentation, cryptography/HSM/key management, tokenization, secrets management, and secure key ceremonies for cryptocustody. 

Cloud, DevSecOps & Product Security
• Embed Security-by-Design and Privacy-by-Design across the SDLC for payment gateways, issuing platforms, APIs, mobile/web apps, merchant/partner portals, and crypto wallets.
• Own a modern DevSecOps toolchain: SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets scanning, IaC scanning, container & K8s posture (CSPM/KSPM), and policy-as-code in CI/CD.
• Operate a cloud security program across AWS/GCP/Azure: landing zones, guardrails, workload identity, CNAPP, runtime protection, and continuous compliance.
• Partner with Engineering and Product to secure new payment products, BaaS/issuing APIs, open banking integrations, crypto on/off-ramp and custody, and AI/ML use cases.
• Champion fraud and financial-crime prevention with Risk, Fraud, and AML −3DS2, device fingerprinting, behavioral biometrics, transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, and Travel Rule for crypto flows.

Identity, Access & Insider Risk
• Own enterprise identity (SSO, MFA, PAM, IGA), least-privilege enforcement, joiner/mover/leaver processes, and privileged access to production and payment systems.
• Run an insider risk and data loss prevention (DLP) program covering cardholder data, PII, and sensitive financial information.
Business Continuity & Cyber Resilience
• Own cyber-resilience, DR, and business continuity planning for critical payment processing services, ensuring RTO/RPO meet regulatory and scheme requirements.
• Run regular tabletop exercises, ransomware simulations, and crisis-management drills with executive participation. Corporate IT Management & Modernization (Additional Responsibility)
• Own end-to-end Corporate IT: infrastructure, networking, end-user computing, collaboration suites ( Google Workspace), SaaS administration, telephony, and meeting rooms across all offices and a globally distributed remote workforce.
• Drive the Corporate IT modernization roadmap: cloud-first, SaaS-first, MDM/UEM, passwordless identity and convergence of corporate networking.
• Own IT asset and SaaS lifecycle management, software licensing, spend optimization (FinOps for SaaS), and IT vendor / contract management.
• Ensure secure, automated onboarding/offboarding for employees and contractors, including device provisioning, access entitlements (joiner/mover/leaver), and data recovery.
• Manage the Corporate IT budget, capacity planning, and operational efficiency; align corporate IT controls with security, privacy, and regulatory requirements (incl. DORA ICT scope).
• Support M&A integration of acquired entities’ IT estates -consolidating identity, endpoints, SaaS, and networking into the group standard.

People, Culture & Awareness
• Build, mentor, and retain a high-performing security and IT organization; define career paths, hiring plans, and succession.
• Run enterprise-wide security awareness, phishing simulations, and role-based training for engineers, operations, and customer-facing teams.
• Foster a strong security and service culture that treats security as a business enabler, not a blocker.

Budget & Vendor Management
• Own consolidated Security + Corporate IT budget (capex and opex); optimize spend across tooling, services, and headcount.
• Manage strategic relationships with security vendors, MSSPs, cloud providers, QSAs, auditors, and IT service partners.

Requirements:
• 7+ years in information security, with 5+ years in a CISO, Deputy CISO, or equivalent C-
suite role inside a PSP, acquirer, issuer/BaaS provider, card network, EMI, bank, or regulated fintech operating in EU or US.
• Demonstrated hands-on accountability for PCI DSS Level 1 (RoC), PSD2/SCA, GDPR, SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001 programs; working knowledge of DORA, NIS2, and MiCA.
• Proven experience leading security across acquiring/gateway and card issuing or BaaS stacks; familiarity with crypto / Web3 payment rails and custody is required.
• Deep technical fluency in cloud security (AWS/GCP/Azure), Kubernetes, API security, DevSecOps toolchains, cryptography, HSM/KMS, tokenization, and Zero Trust.
• Track record of leading 24/7 SOC and incident response for material cyber, fraud, and payment incidents -including regulator, card-scheme, and partner-bank communications.

Title: Lead Generation Specialist (LinkedIn)
Description:
About WeSoftYou
At WeSoftYou, we build custom digital products for startups and enterprises across AI, EdTech, Fintech, and Web3. From MVPs to complex platforms, we help clients go from idea to launch — fast, smart, and with real impact.
 
About the Role
We are looking for a LinkedIn Outbound Specialist to build and run our LinkedIn-driven lead generation channel, targeting Enterprise AI companies in the United States.
 
You own the top of the funnel: ICP targeting, prospect research, outbound sequences, and first-touch qualification. Your primary metric is qualified meetings booked — discovery calls handed off to a closer with enough context to move the deal forward.
 
This is not a closing role. This is not a content or brand-building role. This is not a reactive SDR waiting for inbound. This is an outbound machine role — you build the pipe, qualify what comes in, and hand off when the signal is right.
 
What You’ll Do
1. ICP Targeting & Prospect List Building
Define and segment the Ideal Customer Profile for Enterprise AI US: company stage, vertical, buyer persona, trigger events (funding rounds, new hires, product launches)
Build and maintain target account lists in LinkedIn Sales Navigator using Boolean filters and account tiers (Tier 1 / Tier 2 / cold)
Enrich contacts beyond surface data: funding events, tech stack signals, hiring patterns, leadership changes
Own the research layer end to end — Apollo for contact data, Clay for enrichment workflows, Perplexity and Claude for account-level context
Treat the prospect list as a living asset: clean, tiered, updated weekly
2. Outbound Sequence Design & A/B Testing
Design and run multi-touch outbound sequences across LinkedIn and email
Write messaging that sounds like a human, not a template: hooks specific to vertical, stage, and trigger event — no automation-speak
Run structured A/B tests; track connection accept rate, reply rate, positive reply rate, and meeting booked rate by sequence step
Ship sequence v2 every 2–4 weeks based on data, not instinct
3. First-Touch Qualification
Handle all replies from outbound sequences: follow up, answer questions, overcome first objections
Qualify incoming interest against defined ICP criteria: budget signals, decision authority, project fit, timeline
Book discovery calls and prep a qualification brief for the closer: who the prospect is, what triggered their interest, what they said about budget and scope
Own the quality of what gets handed off — a bad meeting is worse than no meeting
4. CRM & Pipeline Discipline (Pipedrive)
Create and maintain lead records from the moment a prospect replies
Log key context: sequence used, reply trigger, qualification signal, next step
Keep handoff data clean so the closer walks into every call with full context
Track funnel conversion at each step: connection → reply → positive reply → meeting booked → SQL
5. Channel Performance & Iteration
Run a weekly self-audit: where is the funnel leaking, which segment is converting, which sequence is dying
Propose experiments with a defined hypothesis and success metric — not “let’s try something different”
Treat your AI-assisted research and enrichment workflows as a product: versioned, documented, improvable
Share what’s working with the Upwork Sales team; steal what works across directions.
 

What We’re Looking For
2+ years of LinkedIn outbound experience targeting the US market
Proven track record of booking qualified meetings, not just sending volume: you can show reply rates, meeting rates, and what you changed when they dropped
Experience working with Enterprise buyer personas: VP+, CTO, Head of Product at companies 100 —1000+ employees
Native-level written English — your messages must be indistinguishable from a US-based SDR’s;
Hands-on experience with LinkedIn Sales Navigator and at least one sequencing tool (HeyReach, Lemlist, or similar)
AI Fluency: Capable level minimum — you use AI regularly in your research, personalization, or enrichment workflow with a measurable before/after. You’ll walk us through a specific example in the interview.

Title: Tech Lead Engineer (Orchestration)
Description:
Our Mission and Vision
At Solidgate, our mission is clear: to empower outstanding entrepreneurs to build exceptional internet companies. We exist to fuel the builders — the ones shaping the digital economy — with the financial infrastructure they deserve. To achieve that, we're on a bold path: to become the #1 payments orchestration platform in the world.
We believe the future of payments is shaped by people who think big, take ownership, and bring curiosity and drive to everything they do. That's exactly the kind of teammates we want on board.
Solidgate is part of Endeavor — a global community of the world's most impactful entrepreneurs. We're proud to be the first payment orchestrator from Europe to join — and to share our expertise within a network of outstanding global companies.
 
About the Team and Role
You'll join the Orchestration team and take ownership of the Payment Router — one of the core components of our platform. It lets merchants and operations specialists flexibly configure routing and processing rules, so they integrate with us once instead of connecting to a dozen different providers, and get the best conversion thanks to our business logic.
This is a high-load, technologically complex product with strict requirements for correctness, reliability, high availability, and low latency. We're currently exploring AI-driven options to simplify configuration for our merchants — so there's plenty of interesting work ahead.
This is a leadership role, and we want to be upfront about the path to it. Because of the depth of the domain and our experience onboarding leads, the first 6–9 months are focused on working as a Senior Engineer — getting deep into the product, the architecture, and the team — before stepping into the Tech Lead role in full. You'll be mentored and onboarded directly by the team's manager throughout this transition.
Your team — 4 Go Engineers, 2 Frontend Engineers, Product Manager, AQA Engineer.
Explore our technology stack ➡️ here.
 
What you'll own
Your focus will be on:
leading the team technically and as a people manager — mentoring engineers, setting up processes, prioritizing work, and giving constructive feedback
designing key services of our distributed system
building new functionality and supporting and improving existing services
making architectural decisions and setting technical direction
balancing priorities between completing our routing migration (V1 → V2), shipping new features, and steadily reducing tech debt
This is a hands-on leadership role: expect to spend roughly 50–60% of your time coding. We don't have "pure managers" here — leads stay close to the product through code.
We rely on automated testing over manual QA, with a modern CI/CD pipeline, test coverage, and Blue-Green Deployment. We deploy several times a day and ship merchant-facing features within each quarter.
 
You're a great fit if you have
6+ years of backend engineering experience
Strong experience with distributed systems
Solid experience with PostgreSQL
Experience with message brokers (Kafka / RabbitMQ)
Strong backend skills in a statically typed language (Java/Kotlin/TypeScript/etc.)
Understanding of high-load system design
People-management experience (~1.5–2 years ideal; we'll also consider a strong Senior ready to grow into the lead role, with a longer ramp-up period)
A proactive, ownership-driven mindset and the ability to explain complex ideas in simple terms
At this stage we value leadership qualities slightly above pure engineering depth: the team already has strong engineers, and what they need is someone who can lead them, set priorities, and keep the high-level picture in focus.
 
Nice to have
Go, AWS SQS, Buf, Protobuf, Node.js
Experience designing and building high-load systems 
Fintech / payments experience
Experience with no-code / low-code automation
 
Why Solidgate?
High-impact role. You'll lead a team that sits right at the center of our platform's evolution — owning a critical component and shaping its direction.
Great product. We've built a fintech powerhouse that scales fast. Solidgate isn't just an orchestration player — it's the financial infrastructure for modern Internet businesses. From subscriptions to chargeback management, fraud prevention, and indirect tax — we've got it covered. We hold financial licenses in key regions and are a direct Visa & Mastercard partner and sub-reseller (top 5 globally).
Massive growth opportunity. Solidgate is scaling rapidly — this role will be a career-defining move.
Top-tier tech team. Work alongside our driving force — a proven, results-driven engineering team that delivers.
Modern engineering culture. TBDs, code reviews, solid testing practices, metrics, alerts, and fully automated CI/CD.
💌 The Extras: 30+ days off, unlimited sick leave, free office meals, health coverage, and Apple gear to keep you productive. Courses, conferences, sports and wellness benefits — all designed for ideas, focus, and fun.
Tomorrow's fintech needs your mindset. Come build it with us.
🫂 Know top talent? We're always on the lookout. Refer someone for our role, and if they get hired, there's a bonus waiting for you — simple as that.

Write revenue audit reports (30–45 pages) and process audit reports (25–35 pages)
Build ROI projection models in Excel / Google Sheets

Own 3–4 client audits in parallel at different stages of delivery
Work autonomously — no step-by-step guidance, no micromanagement
Identify both revenue leaks and growth upside — not just surface numbers
Translate findings into clear, decision-ready business insights
Back up every recommendation with revenue logic and ROI modeling
Write well — analytical writing quality directly affects client output quality

Must Have
3+ years in a performance, growth, or analytics role — B2B, SaaS, or digital agency context
GA4 at an advanced level: event-based tracking, conversion paths, attribution models — building setups from scratch, not just reading them
One BI tool (Looker Studio, Metabase, Tableau, or PowerBI) — building self-sufficient dashboards independently
Excel / Google Sheets advanced: pivot tables, financial modeling, lookups, conditional logic
Basic SQL: SELECT, JOINs, GROUP BY
Strong analytical writing — ability to turn data into business-visible, human-readable insights
Structured analytical thinking with a business-outcomes orientation
English B2+

HubSpot or Salesforce admin-level access
CRM attribution tools: Dreamdata, HockeyStack, or similar
Mixpanel or Amplitude
Basic Python for data wrangling
GA4 → BigQuery → Looker integration
SaaS metrics fluency: MRR, NRR, GRR, churn cohorts
DACH market experience
German B1+ (German-speaking candidates are prioritized)

Treat analytics as dashboards and figures without interpretation behind them
Cannot explain clearly why a channel or funnel step is underperforming
Rely on pre-built data infrastructure and cannot build setups from scratch
Are not comfortable working with messy, fragmented, multi-source client data
Cannot back up recommendations with revenue modeling
Are looking for a permanent salaried position from day one — this engagement starts as freelance/contractor

Format: Fully remote, async-first communication
Timezone: Ukraine or CET
Engagement type: Freelance / contractor — starting at ~20 hrs/week, scaling to full load based on delivery performance
No probation period: The first project is the screen. Results delivered → engagement continues and grows.
Growth path: Permanent employment (Festanstellung) option opens at the 6+ month mark

CV review

The case covers funnel leak detection, tracking gap identification, and revenue modeling. This replaces a traditional test task.
Referral check
Offer call

Who We're Looking For
You've worked with fragmented, multi-source client data. You build the infrastructure when it doesn't exist. You know how to turn analytical findings into a story a CEO or CMO will act on — and you can model the revenue impact behind every recommendation. If you need a fully built data stack and a detailed brief to get started, this role isn't the right fit.

Title: Launch Producer
Description:
We are driving a project built around an expert with a powerful background and rock-solid methodology. However, our current social media content strategy is overdue for a complete reboot—organic reach and conversions have dropped, and old launch/warm-up mechanics no longer convert.

Media Buyers / Media Planners: Traffic generation is already set up; you won't need to manage ad cabinets.
SMM Freelancers / Visualizers / Reels Makers: If your expertise is limited to aesthetic grids, trendy transitions, or posting "3 times a week for consistency" without a deep understanding of marketing, psychology, and lead generation—this is not the right fit.
Pure Theorists: Authors of 50-slide strategy decks that look beautiful on paper but are impossible to execute. We need an action-oriented leader focused on execution and business metrics.
 
Your Main Goal
To completely overhaul the expert’s positioning, build a sustainable, organic sales funnel (ToFu 👉 MoFu 👉 BoFu) across Instagram/Telegram/YouTube, and achieve target business metrics (Revenue, ROMI) through systemic launches and content-driven funnels.
 
Key Responsibilities (What You'll Do)
Strategic Producing & Repositioning: Analyze the audience and competitors, uncover the expert's new unique value proposition, and map out a refreshed "meaning and message" framework.
Content Funnel Architecture: Design the customer journey from the very first Reels/Shorts interaction to the purchase of our flagship product. Every single piece of content must have a measurable objective and conversion goal.
Expert Extraction (Sourcing Content): Conduct regular briefings, interviews, and deep-dives with the expert to extract unique case studies, methodologies, and stories. Translate complex professional jargon into high-converting hooks and value propositions.
Streamlining the Expert’s Resources: Organize the production workflow so the expert spends minimal time filming or drafting content while achieving maximum commercial leverage (e.g., using precise script structures and batch-filming frameworks).
Launch Management & Multi-Format Warm-ups: Develop and execute strategic content warm-ups (progrevs) tailored for free events, webinars, challenges, or direct sales. Adapt core messages across Reels, long-form posts, articles, and live streams.
Team Coordination & Management: Act as the heartbeat of the content department. You will manage and coordinate a team of remote contractors (copywriters, graphic designers, video editors), ensuring deadlines and high-quality standards are met.
Performance Tracking & HADI Cycles: Constantly analyze funnel metrics (conversion rates at each stage, CPL, CPA, ROMI), test new creative hypotheses, and rapidly adjust the strategy based on data.
 
What We Expect From Your Experience
Proven Track Record in Expert/EdTech Producing: A strong portfolio of successful launches or systemic blog growth that directly resulted in revenue (backed by real numbers and data).
Deep Mastery of Content Marketing & Sales Psychology: You know exactly how to hook a cold audience and how to nurture a warm base without causing audience burnout.
Business-First, Metric-Driven Mindset: You measure content success by CPA, CPL, ROMI, and application volume, rather than just "likes, views, and reach."
Strong Project Management Skills: Ability to write clear Briefs/Task Specifications, manage a creative team, and take full accountability for deadlines.
Highly Structured Approach: Your strategic thinking translates into clear MindMaps, structured tables, content matrices, and actionable step-by-step roadmaps.
 
Bonus Points If You Have
Proficiency with automation tools (mapping out chat-bot logic via ManyChat/SmartSender, CRM marketing).
Experience working on a CPA or Revenue Share model.
Skill in combining social media warm-ups with email marketing sequences or automated webinar funnels.
 
Expected Deliverables in the First 30–60 Days
Audit & Re-positioning Framework: A comprehensive blueprint outlining the expert's revised brand messaging and positioning strategy.
Funnel Architecture Map: A visualized layout of the customer journey from cold traffic discovery to final purchase conversion.
Documented Launch & Media Plan: A transparent, structured operational plan for all content activities (Reels, challenges, lives) with forecasted KPIs.
Operational MVP Content Workflow: A seamless batching and creation process where the expert records via your scripts, and the team delivers polished assets with zero delays.
 
If you are ready to take a high-quality product, structure it, and build a content empire that converts—send over your CV along with your launch/producing case studies.

Title: Chief Information Security Officer
Description:
TodaPay is an international fintech company operating in the digital payments and financial infrastructure space across multiple jurisdictions. We support high-growth payment operations with multi-currency transactions, crypto payments, and complex corporate structures.
We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Accountant to join our Finance team and support core accounting operations, financial reporting, payroll processing, and coordination with external accountants and auditors across jurisdictions.

The Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) is the C-suite executive accountable for
information security, cyber resilience, and corporate IT operations across the group. Operating
in a regulated, multi-jurisdictional PSP and fintech environment spanning card acquiring &
gateway, card issuing / BaaS, and crypto / Web3 payment rails, the CISO defines and executes
the enterprise security strategy, safeguards cardholder data, customer funds, private keys, and
proprietary platforms, and ensures continuous compliance with PCI DSS, PSD2/SCA, GDPR,
DORA, NIS2, MiCA, SOC 2, ISO 27001, FCA/EBA expectations, and equivalent requirements in
other operating jurisdictions. In addition to leading security, the CISO owns corporate IT
— internal infrastructure, endpoints, identity, productivity tooling, and IT service delivery -and
drives its modernization in lockstep with business growth.

Key Responsibilities:
Security Strategy & Governance
• Define, own, and execute the multi-year information security and cyber resilience
strategy aligned with business growth, product roadmap, and regulatory obligations.
• Establish and maintain the Information Security Management System (ISMS) based on
ISO 27001, NIST CSF, and PCI DSS control frameworks.
• Report security posture, risks, incidents, and investment needs to the CEO, Executive
Committee, and Board on a regular cadence.
• Set and enforce enterprise security policies, standards, and acceptable use across all
business units.

Regulatory Compliance & Risk Management
• Maintain continuous compliance with PCI DSS Level 1, PSD2/SCA, GDPR, DORA,
NIS2, MiCA (for crypto activity), SOC 1/SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001/27017/27018, and
EBA/FCA guidelines, plus equivalent obligations in other operating jurisdictions.
• Own the security risk register, third-party / vendor risk program, and risk treatment plans;
ensure alignment with enterprise risk management and the CRO.
• Lead external and internal audits, QSA assessments, penetration tests, and regulatory
examinations; remediate findings within agreed timelines.
• Oversee data protection program in coordination with the DPO, including DPIAs, data
residency, cross-border transfers, and breach notification procedures.

Cybersecurity Operations & Engineering
• Operate a 24/7 Security Operations Center (SOC) covering threat detection, monitoring, incident response, digital forensics, and threat intelligence across acquiring, issuing, and crypto rails.
• Lead the response to security incidents, payment fraud events, account-takeover, and data breaches; act as the primary executive interface with regulators (FCA, EBA,national CAs), card schemes, acquirers, and law enforcement during incidents.
• Mature vulnerability management, red/purple teaming, and threat hunting across multicloud (AWS/GCP/Azure), Kubernetes, on-prem, PCI cardholder data environments(CDE), and crypto custody/HSM enclaves.
• Drive Zero Trust architecture, network segmentation, cryptography/HSM/key management, tokenization, secrets management, and secure key ceremonies for cryptocustody. 

Cloud, DevSecOps & Product Security
• Embed Security-by-Design and Privacy-by-Design across the SDLC for payment gateways, issuing platforms, APIs, mobile/web apps, merchant/partner portals, and crypto wallets.
• Own a modern DevSecOps toolchain: SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets scanning, IaC scanning, container & K8s posture (CSPM/KSPM), and policy-as-code in CI/CD.
• Operate a cloud security program across AWS/GCP/Azure: landing zones, guardrails, workload identity, CNAPP, runtime protection, and continuous compliance.
• Partner with Engineering and Product to secure new payment products, BaaS/issuing APIs, open banking integrations, crypto on/off-ramp and custody, and AI/ML use cases.
• Champion fraud and financial-crime prevention with Risk, Fraud, and AML −3DS2, device fingerprinting, behavioral biometrics, transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, and Travel Rule for crypto flows.

Identity, Access & Insider Risk
• Own enterprise identity (SSO, MFA, PAM, IGA), least-privilege enforcement, joiner/mover/leaver processes, and privileged access to production and payment systems.
• Run an insider risk and data loss prevention (DLP) program covering cardholder data, PII, and sensitive financial information.
Business Continuity & Cyber Resilience
• Own cyber-resilience, DR, and business continuity planning for critical payment processing services, ensuring RTO/RPO meet regulatory and scheme requirements.
• Run regular tabletop exercises, ransomware simulations, and crisis-management drills with executive participation. Corporate IT Management & Modernization (Additional Responsibility)
• Own end-to-end Corporate IT: infrastructure, networking, end-user computing, collaboration suites ( Google Workspace), SaaS administration, telephony, and meeting rooms across all offices and a globally distributed remote workforce.
• Drive the Corporate IT modernization roadmap: cloud-first, SaaS-first, MDM/UEM, passwordless identity and convergence of corporate networking.
• Own IT asset and SaaS lifecycle management, software licensing, spend optimization (FinOps for SaaS), and IT vendor / contract management.
• Ensure secure, automated onboarding/offboarding for employees and contractors, including device provisioning, access entitlements (joiner/mover/leaver), and data recovery.
• Manage the Corporate IT budget, capacity planning, and operational efficiency; align corporate IT controls with security, privacy, and regulatory requirements (incl. DORA ICT scope).
• Support M&A integration of acquired entities’ IT estates -consolidating identity, endpoints, SaaS, and networking into the group standard.

People, Culture & Awareness
• Build, mentor, and retain a high-performing security and IT organization; define career paths, hiring plans, and succession.
• Run enterprise-wide security awareness, phishing simulations, and role-based training for engineers, operations, and customer-facing teams.
• Foster a strong security and service culture that treats security as a business enabler, not a blocker.

Budget & Vendor Management
• Own consolidated Security + Corporate IT budget (capex and opex); optimize spend across tooling, services, and headcount.
• Manage strategic relationships with security vendors, MSSPs, cloud providers, QSAs, auditors, and IT service partners.

Requirements:
• 7+ years in information security, with 5+ years in a CISO, Deputy CISO, or equivalent C-
suite role inside a PSP, acquirer, issuer/BaaS provider, card network, EMI, bank, or regulated fintech operating in EU or US.
• Demonstrated hands-on accountability for PCI DSS Level 1 (RoC), PSD2/SCA, GDPR, SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001 programs; working knowledge of DORA, NIS2, and MiCA.
• Proven experience leading security across acquiring/gateway and card issuing or BaaS stacks; familiarity with crypto / Web3 payment rails and custody is required.
• Deep technical fluency in cloud security (AWS/GCP/Azure), Kubernetes, API security, DevSecOps toolchains, cryptography, HSM/KMS, tokenization, and Zero Trust.
• Track record of leading 24/7 SOC and incident response for material cyber, fraud, and payment incidents -including regulator, card-scheme, and partner-bank communications.
• Direct accountability for corporate IT operations at scale (service desk, endpoint, M365 /Google Workspace, identity, networking) and for leading an IT modernization program.
• Strong partnership track record with Fraud, AML, and Financial Crime teams -including transaction monitoring, sanctions, and Travel Rule implementation.
• Experience reporting to Boards, Risk & Audit Committees, regulators, and external auditors.
• Relevant certifications: CISSP, CISM, CISA, CRISC, CCSP, or equivalent.

Nice to Have:
• Experience with issuing/processing platforms (e.g., Marqeta, Galileo, Paymentology, in-house BIN-sponsored issuing) and acquiring stacks.
• Hands-on familiarity with crypto custody (MPC / HSM), stablecoin rails, on/off-ramp flows, and Travel Rule tooling (e.g., TRP, Notabene, Sumsub).
• Open Banking, embedded finance, and BaaS exposure.
• Experience scaling security and IT through rapid headcount growth, geographic expansion, and M&A integration.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Equals5 helps pharmaceutical companies run precisely targeted ad campaigns on social platforms by identifying healthcare professionals and the consumer signals that reach them. The Identity team builds the data, scoring, and targeting systems that make this possible.
 
We are looking for a Data Analyst  to join the Identity team at Equals5. This is not a standard analyst role. We are building a dynamic identity resolution system where AI is deeply integrated — both as a productivity multiplier and as a core component of our data processing logic for identity resolution and LLM-based scoring.
 
We run enrichment against 70+ TB of data, apply AI and LLM-based scoring on top, and process around 20 million enrichment operations per day across hundreds of thousands of records.
 
The analytical challenges ahead are substantial: how to measure the quality of AI-driven scoring, how to validate that a change makes the system better, how to know where our money and time deliver the most value, and how to turn the questions our internal teams bring in into fast data-backed answers. You will own this side of the business, working daily alongside engineers and the product lead to turn these challenges into decisions that ship.
 
The main part of the role is not building dashboards — it is the data work that makes a meaningful dashboard possible in the first place. Concretely, you will be:
 
Looking at data from multiple vendors side by side and deciding what to trust.
Reconciling entities across sources that have different shapes and quality.
Proposing and validating the logic that matches and scores them.
Defining metrics and ground truth for questions nobody has asked before.
Tracing why numbers don't line up across partial and sometimes contradictory sources.
 
Dashboards and visualizations are part of how findings get communicated, but they come at the end — the surface of the work, not its core. Most of your time is spent on what sits underneath: methodology, judgment calls on data quality, and shaping how the domain understands its own numbers.

Responsibilities
Measurement & Evaluation Foundations: Define how we measure what matters — data quality, the accuracy of our AI scoring, how many records actually get matched to usable signals, cost per outcome. Build the feedback loops that tell us whether a change makes the system better or worse.
 
Scoring Intelligence (co-owned with engineers): Partner with the engineering team on the LLM-based scoring system. You will build the evaluation framework for AI scoring, run experiments comparing prompts, models, and approaches against a baseline, and make data-backed calls on where we invest next. Our AI scoring system is actively evolving — you will shape how we measure and improve it.
 
Client-related Analysis: Own the analytical side of the work that internal sales and media-buying teams bring in from pharma clients — how reachable a target audience is, how good the data looks, why a campaign performed the way it did. You turn their questions into data-backed answers they can use. Identity is a product core; the analyst works with internal teams, not with clients directly.
 
Cost and Value Analysis: Turn cost and value into product decisions. Which data sources and enrichment scenarios pay off, where we overspend, what to cache, what to cut. We operate a mix of free owned data and paid external providers — the decisions have real dollar impact.
 
Active AI Usage: Use Claude Code and modern AI engineering tools to multiply your own output. Automate the repetitive parts of analysis so you can focus on the decisions. We provide Claude Code licenses and expect active daily use.
 
Data Quality Response: When pipeline output drifts, a provider degrades, or upstream data shifts, you notice first, diagnose the root cause, and drive the fix. You treat data quality as a product, not a ticket queue.

Requirements
5+ years as a Data Analyst, Analytics Engineer, or Data Scientist in a product team (not consultancy, not BI-only roles).
Advanced SQL at TB scale — BigQuery, Snowflake, or equivalent warehouse. You can read and write complex queries on tens of terabytes without someone pre-modelling the data for you.
Python for analysis at a working level — pandas, Jupyter, or modern equivalents. Comfortable putting together a small script or helper when an existing tool doesn't cover your case.
Built measurement or evaluation frameworks from scratch for systems that had no baseline. You are comfortable defining what and how to measure, not consuming someone else's KPI.
Comfort with probabilistic systems. You understand that noise is inherent and 100% accuracy is not the goal — scoring, matching, ranking.
AI-native workflow. You already use Claude Code, ChatGPT, Copilot, or similar AI tools daily and integrate them into your analytical process.
English: B2+ (Upper-Intermediate) or higher.

Strong plus 
LLM evaluation experience — A/B testing AI-powered features, output scoring, prompt iteration with measurable outcomes.
Identity resolution / identity graph experience — adtech, martech, or customer data platform context (LiveIntent, LiveRamp, Epsilon, Experian Marketing, Acxiom, Merkle, or similar).
Healthcare or pharma data — working with NPI, HCP-level data, healthcare taxonomies, pharma targeting.

Nice to have
Experience running controlled experiments on data pipelines.
Prompt engineering or structured LLM prompt design.
Prior work in AI-first product companies.
 
What We Offer
Fully remote with flexible hours, with working overlap in CET ±2 hours for syncs.
AI-Native Environment: We provide licenses for Claude Code and encourage using the bleeding edge of AI tech — both for daily work and as part of product logic.
High-Impact Role: You will directly shape how we identify, score, and reach healthcare professionals — the core business of our domain.

Join a Company That Invests in You
Seeking Alpha is the world’s leading community of engaged investors. What We're Looking For
﻿Role Overview: We are developing Ask Seeking Alpha — a high-load financial analysis system based on Large Language Models. The architecture is built on complex multi-agent orchestration using LangGraph, FastAPI, and Elasticsearch.
We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer specialized in Generative AI to design agent workflows, optimize interactions with models (OpenAI, AWS Bedrock), and ensure the reliability of non-deterministic systems in production.
The Senior Python AI Engineer will be engaged with the company as a contractor (Private Entrepreneur).
 
Tech Stack: Python (Asyncio), FastAPI, LangChain, LangGraph, Pydantic, Elasticsearch, AWS Bedrock / OpenAI API, LangSmith.
What You'll Do
Agent Architecture: Design and implement complex agent orchestration logic using LangGraph. You will define state management, conditional routing, and error handling within the agent graph.
Tool Engineering: Build and optimize the tool layer (function calling) that allows LLMs to interact with internal financial APIs and databases accurately.
Performance Optimization:
-Reduce end-to-end latency through asynchronous processing and streaming (SSE).
-Implement semantic caching strategies to minimize API costs and response time.
-Optimize token usage without sacrificing answer quality.
Observability & Evaluation: Implement automated evaluation pipelines using LangSmith. You will be responsible for setting up regression testing for prompts and agents to measure quality (correctness, faithfulness) before deployment.
Advanced RAG: Refine retrieval strategies. Work on hybrid search implementation (Keyword + Vector), re-ranking, and query expansion to feed the most relevant context to the model.
Requirements
Python Expert: Strong proficiency in modern Python. Deep understanding of asynchronous programming (asyncio) patterns is mandatory, as our entire I/O pipeline (Network, DB, LLM) is non-blocking. Experience with FastAPI and Pydantic (v2).
Agentic Frameworks: Production experience with LangChain. Hands-on experience or deep conceptual understanding of LangGraph (or similar state-machine-based agent frameworks).
Deep LLM Expertise (What we mean by "Deep"):
Non-determinism Management: Strategies for handling LLM hallucinations and ensuring reliable outputs (e.g., self-correction loops, specific prompting techniques like CoT/ReAct).
Structured Outputs: Experience forcing LLMs to adhere to strict schemas (Pydantic/JSON mode) for reliable downstream processing.
Context Optimization: Advanced strategies for managing limited context windows (summarization chains, sliding windows, selective context injection) beyond simple truncation.
Inference Economics: Understanding the trade-offs between model size, latency, and cost (e.g., when to route to GPT-4 vs. a smaller/faster model).
Nice to Have
Experience with Elasticsearch (DSL queries, analyzers).
Knowledge of vector databases and embedding models.
Background in FinTech or familiarity with financial data structures.

Title: Creative Strategist (Paid Meta)
Description:

What You’ll Own:
Build and manage a structured creative testing system across hooks, angles, formats, and offers.
Develop creative hypotheses based on audience insights, competitor research, and performance data.
Prioritize what to test first — and know when to kill what isn’t working.

Decide when a creative deserves a second chance and when it gets cut.
Translate data into actionable creative iterations — new hooks, packaging, edits, or formats.
Analyze competitors through Meta Ads Library, TikTok Creative Center, Amazon reviews, and customer feedback.
Identify angles worth testing vs. formats worth adapting (and know the difference).
Build audience segments based on motivations, awareness levels, and unmet needs.
Brief designers, editors, and copywriters with clarity and creative direction.
Work directly with media buyers to align creative strategy with campaign structure and budget.
Push back — constructively — when creative looks beautiful but won’t convert.
 
You’re the Right Person If:
You have 2+ years of experience in creative strategy for paid social — Meta is a must, TikTok is a strong plus.
You’ve worked in supplements, health & wellness, or beauty — you understand what makes US consumers trust a brand and buy.
You know what a strong hook looks like — and can write one.
You think in systems: backlogs, test structures, iteration cycles.
You can tell the difference between a premium creative and a direct response creative — and know when to use which.
You’ve worked with UGC creators before: you know how to brief them, source them, and get the performance out of them.
You understand landing page logic — the ad promise has to match what the user sees after the click.
You’re proactive: you spot format fatigue before it tanks results and bring solutions, not just observations.
 
What Will Make You Stand Out:
Direct experience with supplement or beauty brands on Meta/TikTok.
Familiarity with Meta Ads Manager at a structural level (campaign architecture, audience logic, creative testing frameworks).
Experience building or scaling a creative testing operation from scratch.
Strong copywriting skills — hooks, CTAs, ad copy that doesn’t ramble.
 
What We Offer:
Competitive salary rate.
Monday-Friday, 10:00—19:00 (flexible hours available)
Full benefits system: equipment, insurance system, training compensation and etc.
Real ownership — you’ll build and run the creative strategy, not execute someone else’s vision.
Direct exposure to the US market — the most competitive and scalable consumer market in the world.
A team that measures creative by its impact on metrics, not by subjective taste
Clear growth path — over 50% of our managers started as specialists.
A fast-moving, international team that moves on decisions and doesn’t sit in approval loops.

We use AI agents internally to monitor stores, investigate issues, and handle operational work that traditional teams do manually. Our support team is built around this: smaller, sharper, more technical, and every person has real ownership over outcomes — not just tickets.
 
The Role

You'll spend a significant part of your time doing actual support work: taking shifts, handling tickets, making calls, troubleshooting issues directly with restaurants. Own complex and escalated issues end-to-end until resolution.
Make and receive support calls; ensure restaurants feel supported and heard.

Lead the support team day-to-day — coordinate coverage, distribute work, make sure nothing falls through the cracks.
Hire and mentor support reps: find high-ownership, technically curious people, onboard them, coach them, help them grow.
Supervise and improve AI agents that handle monitoring, triage, and first-response. Review their work, identify gaps, and work with product/engineering to make them better.

Own support quality — review interactions for tone, accuracy, and resolution. Monitor KPIs. Identify patterns and drive improvements.
Be the voice of the restaurant internally — translate support patterns into product feedback.
 
What We're Looking For
 
Must-haves:
Prior experience leading or coordinating a support team — you've managed people, distributed work, coached reps, and owned quality outcomes. Doesn't have to be a big team; a small, high-performing one is better signal.
High ownership and agency. You don't wait to be told what to do. If something's broken, you fix it or flag it. If a process doesn't exist, you create it. If a customer is upset, you own it until it's resolved.
Excellent English — written and spoken. Our restaurants are US-based; communication quality directly impacts trust.
Comfortable working US timezone hours, including evening, night, and weekend shifts as part of near-24/7 coverage rotation.

Experience in restaurant tech, hospitality tech, or SaaS support for SMBs.
You've built SOPs, playbooks, or knowledge bases that actually get used.
You've worked in a startup or small company where you wore multiple hats and figured things out without a large support infrastructure.
You've managed or supervised automated systems, bots, or AI tools in a support context.
Spanish or Mandarin language skills (many of our restaurant partners speak these).
You've used tools like Intercom, Linear, or similar for support operations.
 
What this role is NOT:
This is not a management-only role. You'll be on the front lines regularly, handling real support alongside your team.
This is not a 9-to-5 role. Restaurants operate evenings and weekends; coverage needs to match.
This is not a role where you can avoid AI. If you're skeptical about AI being a real part of operations, this isn't the right fit.
 
Why This Role
When a restaurant's orders stop flowing, we're the ones they call. You'll own how support works — building the team, the processes, and the human + AI system from early stage. Your decisions will directly shape how things run. If you want to build what an AI-native support team actually looks like — not just manage a queue — this is the role.

Title: AI Prompt Engineer (Hiring Multiple Junior and Senior)
Description:

Salary range:
• Junior: $40,000–$60,000 base + performance bonuses
• Senior: $70,000–$100,000 base + performance bonuses
 
Remote (open to relocation to Las Vegas, NV)
 
Why this role:
Studio's AI influencers live or die by their content. The images, videos, and media they post need to stop thumbs, spark engagement, and build audiences — and all of it starts with how the AI is prompted. Right now, prompt discovery is ad hoc. We need dedicated people whose entire job is to push the platform to its limits: finding the prompts that produce stunning content, the feature combinations that unlock new creative possibilities, and the repeatable strategies that any operator can pick up and run with. You're not engineering software — you're engineering virality.
 
The best prompt engineers will shape how every AI influencer on the platform creates content. Your discoveries won't stay in a doc — they'll become structured, modular prompt templates built into the product for all operators and users to adopt.
 
What you'll do:
• Spend the majority of your time inside Studio, systematically exploring every feature, parameter, and creative workflow to discover what produces the most compelling, viral-ready AI content
• Develop and test prompt strategies across content types — portraits, lifestyle shots, trending formats, video content, and any new media capabilities as they ship
• Discover powerful feature combinations — mixing generation modes, editing tools, style controls, and post-processing in ways that produce results greater than the sum of their parts
• Evaluate every discovery against social media performance criteria: will this stop a scroll? Will this get shared? Will this build an audience? If you can't answer those questions, the prompt doesn't matter
• Build structured, modular prompt templates — reusable formats with clear parameters that operators and users can adopt without needing to understand the underlying craft. Think of these as recipes: specific enough to produce consistent results, flexible enough to adapt to different influencer personas and content niches
• Design prompt architectures that could be productized — your best work will inform structured prompt builders within Studio, giving all users access to sophisticated prompting without requiring expertise
• Document and categorize discoveries by use case, content type, difficulty level, and expected performance — building a living library of proven strategies
• Stay obsessively current on social media content trends — what's performing on Instagram, TikTok, X/Twitter, Facebook, and YouTube — and translate those trends into prompt strategies before competitors catch on
• Test and iterate relentlessly — run A/B comparisons between prompt variations, track what works across different audience types, and refine strategies based on real-world content performance data
 
What we're looking for:
• The most important quality: social media fluency. You must have a deep, intuitive understanding of what performs on social media — what gets engagement, what gets shared, what builds audiences, and what falls flat. Without this, no amount of creativity or analytical ability matters.
• Strong understanding of social media content performance across major platforms — you can look at a piece of content and predict whether it will perform before it's posted. You follow trends obsessively and understand why things go viral, not just that they did
• Creative and experimental mindset — you're the kind of person who spends hours tweaking variables to see what happens. You find the edges of what a tool can do and push past them
• Systematic thinking — you don't just find one great prompt, you figure out why it works and build a repeatable framework around it. Your discoveries are structured and teachable, not one-off lucky shot
 
Interview stages:
Written Pre-screen (4-5 calibration questions from the team)
Call (Culture fit & Domain expertise/technical depth).
Test (Take-home or live assessment to see actual work mechanics)
Call (Test review & decision walkthrough) + 3 professional references required
